name: Riftlight Fault
introDiscord: A brilliant tear cuts through the trench, leaking impossible colors from somewhere that definitely isn't here. Shizuki's first surviving sign reads: 'DO NOT ENTER RIFT.'
introTwitch: A brilliant tear cuts through the trench, leaking impossible colors from somewhere that definitely isn't here. Shizuki's first surviving sign reads: 'DO NOT ENTER RIFT.'

riftlight-fault-approach.prompt: Three paths run alongside the glowing fracture.

left.message: Shizuki's tonic sits beneath another sign: "Seriously. Do not enter glowing dimensional wound."
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the medicine and demonstrate excellent rift etiquette.

right.message: A Riftlight Serpent emerges halfway through the fracture.

forward.message: A star-chart coffer has been warped into an angle that should not exist.

riftlight-fault-depths.prompt: The fault widens. Three paths flicker between slightly different versions of themselves.

left.message:
A Berry floats halfway inside the rift.

Beside it:

"I dropped this.

I am NOT reaching in there.

Future explorer may make own questionable decision."

right.message: A meteor-iron reliquary flickers between two locations.

forward.message: A Riftlight Serpent crosses into your route from somewhere else.

riftlight-fault-threshold.prompt: Radiant Fracture pulses beyond three unstable approaches.

left.message: A Serpent coils across the rift.

right.message:
Shizuki's bottle reads:

"RIFT INCIDENT MEDICINE.

There was no rift incident.

Because I did not enter rift.

Officially."
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the suspiciously specific medicine untouched.

forward.message:
"Star Candies glitter along the fracture's stable edge."

BOSS:

bossPromptDiscord:
The rift opens wider.

Something enormous moves on the other side.

Shizuki's final sign simply says:

"NO."

Use /yes to approach Radiant Fracture or /no to become the first person here to respect the sign.
bossPromptTwitch:
The rift opens wider.

Something enormous moves on the other side.

Shizuki's final sign simply says:

"NO."

Use !yes to approach Radiant Fracture or !no to become the first person here to respect the sign.
bossRetreatText:
You respect the sign.

Somewhere in the universe, Shizuki would be amazed.

boss.revealText:
A colossal serpent tears through the radiant fault.

Fault-Crowned Serpent reveals itself!

completionText:
"The fracture shrinks.

Shizuki's sign remains:

"DO NOT ENTER RIFT."

Good sign."
